Dear Adatum Ltd,

We regret to inform you that your hardware was initially shipped to the wrong site (Austin DC instead of Rotterdam DC-TOAR). As per our policy, we are processing a refund of 45 for the reshipping fee associated with Ticket C-1730. This refund reflects the correction of this error.

**Refund Details:**
- Amount: 45
- Reason: Reshipping fee refund for incorrect hardware delivery (Ticket C-1730)
- Contract Shipping Site (per record): Austin DC

Your account will be credited shortly. If you have any questions, reply to this email or reference Ticket C-1730. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Regards,
IT Operations Team
